entry.title: Taipei Main Station

terrainReference.basis: The photographed approaches have ordinary curb and step heights. Standard Terrarium gives 5.704 m and 5.923 m at the west and northwest outdoor controls, with an elevated 27.725 m return on the south plaza. The bounded 5.80 m visualization grade covers the headhouse and its immediate street approaches and blends back to the host field.

entry.note: The main headhouse occupies its exact mapped footprint and orientation. A bounded 5.80 m visualization grade uses two unobstructed outdoor samples and corrects elevated urban returns around the station. Four two-step approaches lead from the rendered sidewalks to the recessed entrance bays.

review: Verified the four sidewalk joins and the mapped headhouse with bounded local terrain grading.
